title: Shared finite Kummer boundary equation
statement: For the finite intrinsic coefficient category of [def-sp-tower-class-finite], let finiteKummerUnit be the degree-zero single complex of the evaluated regular coefficient module and finiteKummerLine the single finite Tate line shifted by two. For a scheme T, a level n, the specified Kummer sequence k of [def-sp-tower-class-systems], L in Pic(T), and an arrow a between these objects, FiniteKummerBoundary(T,n,k,L,a) is precisely finiteBoundaryEquality for the integral quotient, shifted root-to-tensor map, forgotten a, and evaluated integral Kummer boundary of L, all from [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. This is a named shared expression, with no extra hypotheses and no chosen data.
